diagnosis.attribute_fixtures: Old fixtures assume default [0,0] means no clamp. Current bClampMin/bClampMax default true, so leaving the defaults clamps to zero. Attribute arithmetic, modifier and replay failures are being assessed against these updated semantics.
diagnosis.cooldown_fixtures: Three tests call GenAncillaryTick with DeltaTime expecting countdown subtraction. Current cooldowns store absolute ActionTimer expiry, and ticking without advancing the movement clock does not expire them.
diagnosis.traversal_isolation: All 13 Traversal.Action.CheckResult cases pass in a fresh isolated run; the full suite fails one inset-proxy case. Earlier-test shared-state interference is suspected; the responsible test is not yet identified.
